newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat ready to meet Netanyahu to sew up Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Arafat ready to meet Netanyahu to sew up Hebron.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat is ready to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to remove obstacles holding up a deal to extend PLO self-rule to Hebron, an adviser to Arafat said on Tuesday.

"President Arafat is ready to meet Prime Minister Netanyahu for further talks in order to overcome the obstacles and resolve the remaining issues," adviser Marwan Kanafani told Reuters. PLO officials said the United States, the mediator in the talks, wanted a meeting later on Tuesday.
Netanyahu's office said no meeting had been set. Previous summits have taken place at the Erez crossing between Israel and the self-ruled Gaza Strip.
Israeli-PLO talks on the long-overdue extension of Palestinian self-rule to the West Bank town were snagged on four issues on Tuesday, PLO officials said.
Hebron, a West Bank flashpoint of violence, is home to 400 militant Jewish settlers and 100,000 Arabs.
It was to be handed over to the Palestinians last March but violence, security concerns and Israel's change of government in June delayed the pullback.
